title: Securities Dealing Policy
date_next_review: Periodic review by the Board; no fixed date stated

tiers.name: Personnel
tiers.description: All Directors, employees, officers or contractors engaged by Sandfire or its related bodies corporate, and a company or trust controlled by any of those persons. Subject to the insider trading prohibition, the four Blackout Periods, the short-term dealing and short selling bans, the margin lending ban and the ban on granting security over unvested or holding-locked securities; no prior approval is required for dealings.

tiers.name: Designated Personnel
tiers.description: Each Director of a Group Company, the Executive Leadership Team, any person recorded on a restricted list, and, as it relates to those persons, a company or trust they control and their spouse (including de facto), child (including step or adopted child), close relative, a person financially dependent on them or a person acting in concert with them. Must obtain prior written approval for any dealing, and are prohibited from hedging activity in any circumstances.

tiers.name: Chair of the Board
tiers.description: The Chair of the Sandfire Board, a subset of Designated Personnel, distinguished only in that the Approver for their dealings is the Chair of the Audit and Risk Committee.

tiers.name: Other Directors (including Managing Director)
tiers.description: Directors of a Group Company other than the Chair, including the Managing Director. Approver is the Chair of the Board. Directors have also agreed to provide details of changes in their holdings to the Company Secretary as soon as reasonably possible so Sandfire can report within five business days.

tiers.name: Executive Leadership Team (other than Managing Director)
tiers.description: Members of the Executive Leadership Team other than the Managing Director. Approver is the Chair of the Board. Within Designated Personnel and therefore prohibited from hedging in any circumstances.

definitions.hedging_definition: Hedging includes entering transactions in financial products (using derivatives or otherwise) that operate to limit the economic risk associated with holding Sandfire securities.

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: The Board may specify any other blackout period from time to time. Separately, Sandfire may notify Personnel that they must not deal, either for a specified period or until further notice, and the Company Secretary maintains records of issued Blackout Period and insider trading restriction communications and of any other person not able to deal as the Board determines. A refusal or revocation of approval must be kept confidential and no reasons need be given.

rules.detail: The express permission to hedge vested and unrestricted securities is withdrawn from Designated Personnel, who are banned from hedging activity in any circumstances. Since Designated Personnel captures every Director of a Group Company, the Executive Leadership Team, restricted list members and their controlled entities and family, this removes the collar for exactly the population a bank would target.
rules.evidence: This permission does not apply to Designated Personnel. Designated Personnel are prohibited from hedging activity in any circumstances.

rules.detail: Personnel who are not Designated Personnel may hedge vested and unrestricted Sandfire securities, but the hedge is itself a dealing, so it cannot be entered, renewed, altered or closed out in a Blackout Period or while the person holds market sensitive information, and the short-term dealing and short selling restrictions still apply.
rules.evidence: Personnel are permitted to hedge their vested and unrestricted Sandfire securities provided the hedge transaction is treated as a dealing in Sandfire securities for the purposes of this Policy.

rules.detail: Participants in an employee, executive or director equity plan must not hedge securities allocated under the plan while they remain subject to the plan rules.
rules.evidence: Personnel who participate in an employee, executive or director equity plan operated by Sandfire must not enter any hedging arrangement that limits the economic risk of holding Sandfire securities allocated under such plan while those securities remain subject to the rules of that plan or are subject to a holding lock.

rules.detail: The plan hedging ban runs until the securities are both free of the plan rules and free of any holding lock, so vesting alone does not release them into the hedgeable pool.
rules.evidence: while those securities remain subject to the rules of that plan or are subject to a holding lock.

rules.detail: A purchased put and written call over Sandfire securities are transactions in financial products using derivatives that operate to limit the economic risk of holding those securities, so they fall within the defined term Hedging and within the absolute prohibition on Designated Personnel hedging activity. There is no venue limitation.
rules.evidence: Hedging includes entering transactions in financial products (using derivatives or otherwise) that operate to limit the economic risk associated with holding Sandfire securities.

rules.detail: Non-designated Personnel may use derivatives to hedge vested and unrestricted securities, but must avoid instruments that are short term or speculative or that otherwise enable them to profit from a decrease in the market price of securities, and must transact outside a Blackout Period.
rules.evidence: Personnel are permitted to hedge their vested and unrestricted Sandfire securities provided the hedge transaction is treated as a dealing in Sandfire securities for the purposes of this Policy.

rules.detail: Exchange traded options, share warrants and similar instruments are named as examples of prohibited short-term dealings where they are short term or speculative, subject only to an Approver's approval in an exceptional circumstance.
rules.evidence: entering other short-term dealings (for example, transactions in derivative markets involving exchange traded options, share warrants, contracts for difference and other similar instruments, which are short term or speculative)

rules.detail: Monetisation is not named. A prepaid forward or similar structure operates to limit the economic risk of holding Sandfire securities and is therefore Hedging, banned for Designated Personnel in any circumstances. An outright sale with approval, or a Standing Order under the Shareholding Guideline, is the sanctioned route to cash.
rules.evidence: Designated Personnel are prohibited from hedging activity in any circumstances.

rules.section: Hedging; No margin lending arrangements or granting of security over Sandfire securities
rules.detail: For non-designated Personnel a monetisation of vested unrestricted securities is permitted as a hedge and, because the security-granting ban is confined to unvested or holding-locked securities, may be secured on those shares provided it is not a margin lending arrangement.
rules.evidence: Personnel may not at any time, directly or indirectly, grant any form of security (whether by way of charge, mortgage, pledge or otherwise) over any Sandfire securities that are unvested or subject to a holding lock

rules.detail: Short selling by any Personnel is prohibited unless an Approver has approved the dealing in an exceptional circumstance. The related words 'or otherwise enable Personnel to profit from a decrease in the market price of securities' broaden the restriction well beyond conventional short selling.
rules.evidence: Unless an Approver has otherwise approved the dealing in an exceptional circumstance in accordance with this Policy, Personnel must not deal in Sandfire securities on a short-term trading basis or engage in short selling any Sandfire securities.

rules.detail: Securities lending is not named and is not within the description of dealing, which covers buying or selling securities or agreeing to do so, procuring another person to deal, and passing on market sensitive information.
Contracts for difference are named expressly as an example of prohibited short-term dealing, subject only to an Approver's approval in an exceptional circumstance.
rules.evidence: transactions in derivative markets involving exchange traded options, share warrants, contracts for difference and other similar instruments, which are short term or speculative

rules.section: No margin lending arrangements or granting of security over Sandfire securities
rules.detail: Any dealing pursuant to a margin lending arrangement is prohibited for all Personnel, expressly including entering the arrangement, transferring Sandfire securities into an existing margin loan account and selling Sandfire securities to satisfy a margin call. The only relief is an Approver's approval in an exceptional circumstance.
rules.evidence: This includes: entering a margin lending arrangement in respect of Sandfire's securities; transferring securities in Sandfire into an existing margin loan account; and selling Sandfire securities to satisfy a call pursuant to a margin loan.

rules.section: No margin lending arrangements or granting of security over Sandfire securities
rules.detail: No form of security, direct or indirect, may be granted over unvested Sandfire securities to secure any obligation of the person or of any third party, subject only to an Approver's exceptional circumstance approval.
rules.evidence: Personnel may not at any time, directly or indirectly, grant any form of security (whether by way of charge, mortgage, pledge or otherwise) over any Sandfire securities that are unvested or subject to a holding lock to secure any obligation of that relevant Personnel or any third party.

rules.section: No margin lending arrangements or granting of security over Sandfire securities
rules.detail: The ban extends to securities subject to a holding lock even if they have vested, so the collateral pool must be free of holding locks.
rules.evidence: over any Sandfire securities that are unvested or subject to a holding lock to secure any obligation of that relevant Personnel or any third party.

rules.section: No margin lending arrangements or granting of security over Sandfire securities; Exceptions
rules.detail: The security-granting prohibition is deliberately confined to securities that are unvested or subject to a holding lock, so a charge, mortgage or pledge over vested and unrestricted Sandfire securities is not caught, provided the facility is not a margin lending arrangement. The Exceptions list confirms this by permitting a disposal resulting from a secured lender exercising its rights.
rules.evidence: dispose of securities in the Company where the disposal is the result of a secured lender exercising their rights.

rules.section: No margin lending arrangements or granting of security over Sandfire securities; Exceptions
rules.detail: There is no general ban on secured financing. The only express financing prohibitions are margin lending in any form and the grant of security over unvested or holding-locked securities. The Policy expressly contemplates a secured lender over Sandfire securities by excluding from its procedures a disposal resulting from that lender exercising its rights, which must be notified to the Company Secretary within two business days. Designated Personnel would still need prior approval for the dealing that creates the security.
rules.evidence: dispose of securities in the Company where the disposal is the result of a secured lender exercising their rights.

rules.detail: Short-term trading is buying and selling securities within a three month period, and also entering other short-term dealings such as exchange traded options, warrants and contracts for difference that are short term or speculative, or that otherwise enable the person to profit from a decrease in the market price of securities. Relief only by Approver approval in an exceptional circumstance.
rules.evidence: Short-term trading includes buying and selling securities with a 3-month period and entering other short-term dealings (for example, transactions in derivative markets involving exchange traded options, share warrants, contracts for difference and other similar instruments, which are short term or speculative) or otherwise enable Personnel to profit from a decrease in the market price of securities.

financing.minimum_shareholding_requirement: Yes. The Policy is read together with the Shareholding Guideline, including the Share Selling Principles. An application for approval to deal may be refused where the person is not, or as a result of the dealing will not be, in compliance with the Guideline. A person who has not yet reached the required shareholding level may only sell Sandfire securities to cover tax obligations, arranged in advance of vesting via a Standing Order, and entry into the Standing Order is itself a dealing requiring approval. The Policy does not say whether hedged or encumbered securities count toward the Guideline.

exemption_authority: In exceptional circumstances and only with prior approval, Personnel may deal during a Blackout Period 'or in another way otherwise prohibited by this Policy'. Approval is sought from the Company Secretary, with confirmation of no market sensitive information; for Designated Personnel the Company Secretary must also obtain the Approver's approval, and the Remuneration Committee's in certain circumstances. What is exceptional is assessed case by case in the absolute discretion of the Company Secretary and Approver and may include severe financial hardship or compliance with a court order or court enforceable undertaking. Separately, the margin lending, security-granting, short-term dealing and short selling bans are each expressed as subject to an Approver approving the dealing in an exceptional circumstance.
jurisdiction_overlays: Personnel are responsible for ensuring dealings do not breach the securities laws of any other relevant jurisdiction in which the Group operates or where securities may be traded

bespoke_clauses.topic: absolute hedging ban on Designated Personnel
bespoke_clauses.clause: Personnel are permitted to hedge their vested and unrestricted Sandfire securities provided the hedge transaction is treated as a dealing in Sandfire securities for the purposes of this Policy. This permission does not apply to Designated Personnel. Designated Personnel are prohibited from hedging activity in any circumstances.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: This is the decisive clause: every Director, the Executive Leadership Team, restricted list members and their controlled entities and family are banned from the derivative legs outright, so no collar can be offered to them even though the financing side would be workable.

bespoke_clauses.topic: security ban limited to unvested and locked shares
bespoke_clauses.clause: Personnel may not at any time, directly or indirectly, grant any form of security (whether by way of charge, mortgage, pledge or otherwise) over any Sandfire securities that are unvested or subject to a holding lock to secure any obligation of that relevant Personnel or any third party.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Unusually, the encumbrance ban stops at unvested and holding-locked securities, so a charge over vested unrestricted shares is not prohibited and the loan leg of a funded structure is available in principle.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Notwithstanding the procedures set out in this Policy, Personnel may at any time: ... dispose of securities in the Company where the disposal is the result of a secured lender exercising their rights.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Rare and valuable: lender enforcement is carved out of the Blackout Period and approval machinery altogether, subject only to notifying the Company Secretary within two business days, so a bank's security can be enforced without putting the borrower in breach.

bespoke_clauses.clause: any dealing in Sandfire securities by Personnel pursuant to a margin lending arrangement is prohibited. This includes: entering a margin lending arrangement in respect of Sandfire's securities; transferring securities in Sandfire into an existing margin loan account; and selling Sandfire securities to satisfy a call pursuant to a margin loan.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The facility must be a fixed term loan without margin call or top-up mechanics, and the shares must not be moved into a margin account, or the arrangement is caught notwithstanding the narrow security-granting ban.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Short-term trading includes ... entering other short-term dealings (for example, transactions in derivative markets involving exchange traded options, share warrants, contracts for difference and other similar instruments, which are short term or speculative) or otherwise enable Personnel to profit from a decrease in the market price of securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A purchased put pays out as the price falls, so even for non-designated Personnel the collar should be structured and documented as protection of a held position over a tenor beyond three months, not as a speculative instrument.

bespoke_clauses.topic: exceptional circumstances can lift any prohibition
bespoke_clauses.clause: In exceptional circumstances, and only with prior approval, Personnel may deal in Sandfire securities during a Blackout Period, or in another way otherwise prohibited by this Policy.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: This is the only conceivable route for a Designated Person, since it purports to reach any prohibition, but it sits in tension with the statement that Designated Personnel are prohibited from hedging 'in any circumstances' and requires the Company Secretary, the Approver and sometimes the Remuneration Committee to agree.

bespoke_clauses.clause: from the close of trading on the ASX on 31 March or 30 September each year until the commencement of trading on the ASX on the day following the day on which the relevant quarterly report for those financial quarters is released to the ASX
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Quarterly blackouts on top of the half and full year blackouts leave four closed periods a year, so entry, roll and unwind timing is materially constrained for a company on a quarterly reporting cycle.

bespoke_clauses.clause: If approval to deal is granted, the Designated Personnel must undertake the intended dealing within two business days or such longer period that is advised by the approver (which may not be longer than five business days) following the day clearance is given.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Any approved leg must be executed within two business days, extendable to five at the Approver's discretion, and the approval may be revoked at any time before then.

bespoke_clauses.clause: An application for approval to deal in Sandfire securities may be refused where the relevant person is not, or as a result of the proposed dealing will not be, in compliance with the Guideline (including the Share Selling Principles).
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The Company Secretariat Function screens for Guideline compliance before the request even reaches the Approver, so a structure that reduces effective exposure may be refused on that ground.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Where any approval is required for dealing under this Policy, approval will not be granted where the dealing would be perceived that Personnel might be taking advantage of their position or could possibly be damaging to Sandfire's reputation.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: An open-textured veto sitting above the specific rules, which a hedging or financing structure involving a bank would have to survive.

bespoke_clauses.topic: controlled entities and family are Designated Personnel
bespoke_clauses.clause: as it relates to the persons referred to above: a company or trust controlled by any of the persons referred to above; and a spouse (including a de facto spouse), child (including a step-child or adopted child), a close relative, a person financially dependent on or acting in concert with any of the persons referred to above.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The hedging ban follows the shares into family trusts, controlled companies and family members' hands, so the structure cannot be moved to an associate to escape it.

summary: A funded collar is not available to a Sandfire director or executive, but the obstacle is the derivative legs rather than the financing. Sandfire expressly permits Personnel to hedge vested and unrestricted securities, treating the hedge as a dealing, but immediately withdraws that permission from Designated Personnel, who are 'prohibited from hedging activity in any circumstances', and Designated Personnel captures every Director of a Group Company, the Executive Leadership Team, restricted list members and their controlled companies, trusts and close family. The financing side is unusually accommodating: the ban on granting security is confined to securities that are unvested or subject to a holding lock, so a charge over vested unrestricted shares is not prohibited, and the Exceptions list expressly permits a disposal resulting from a secured lender exercising its rights at any time, subject only to notifying the Company Secretary within two business days, although any margin lending arrangement, transfer into a margin account or sale to meet a margin call is banned. The only route for a Designated Person would be the exceptional circumstances power, which purports to permit dealing 'in another way otherwise prohibited by this Policy' with the approval of the Company Secretary, the relevant Approver and sometimes the Remuneration Committee, but that sits in direct tension with the words 'in any circumstances' and is confined to matters such as severe financial hardship or a court order. For non-designated Personnel a funded collar over vested unrestricted shares is genuinely feasible, provided it is not a margin lending arrangement, has a tenor beyond three months and is not structured so as to look like a speculative bet on a price decrease, and is entered outside the four annual blackout periods.
